title: Alphabet discloses $1T+ in purchase commitments, future leases, and other obligations; its Q3 filing shows $98.5B in contingent commitments, up ~$23B from Q2 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Alphabet discloses $1T+ in purchase commitments, future leases, and other obligations; its Q3 filing shows $98.5B in contingent commitments, up ~$23B from Q2 — Alphabet Inc. has said demand for its cloud services is increasing at a rapid clip, pointing to growth in its backlog of cloud contracts that it hasn't yet fulfilled.
